check_dois.name: check_dois

parameters.description: A list from an earlier step, or DOIs separated by commas or new lines. https://doi.org/ links work too.
parameters.name: dois

closed_count.description: How many were found but have no free copy.

found_count.description: How many Unpaywall has a record of.

not_found.description: The entries Unpaywall has no record of, or that aren't DOIs.

open_count.description: How many have a free, legal copy.

results.description: One row per DOI, in the order given; repeats dropped.

best_license.description: The best copy's licence, if known.

best_pdf_url.description: A direct PDF link for the best free copy, if any.

best_url.description: A link to the best free copy: its PDF when there is one.

best_version.description: Which version the best copy is.

doi.description: The DOI, in lowercase, or the entry as given if it isn't one.

error.description: Why there is no record: 'Not a DOI' or 'Not in Unpaywall'. Empty when found.

found.description: Whether Unpaywall has a record of it.

is_oa.description: Whether there is any free, legal copy.

oa_status.description: How it is open: 'gold' (open-access journal), 'diamond' (open-access journal that charges authors nothing), 'hybrid' (open licence in a subscription journal), 'bronze' (free on the publisher's site without an open licence), 'green' (free in a repository) or 'closed'.

parameters.description: The article's DOI, such as 10.1038/nature12373. A https://doi.org/ link works too.

best_host_type.description: Where the best copy is: 'publisher' or 'repository'.

best_landing_page_url.description: The page the best free copy is on.

best_license.description: The best copy's licence, such as 'cc-by', if known.

best_pdf_url.description: A direct PDF link for the best free copy, if any.

best_url.description: A link to the best free copy: its PDF when there is one.

best_version.description: Which version the best copy is: 'publishedVersion', 'acceptedVersion' or 'submittedVersion'.

doi_url.description: The DOI as a https://doi.org/ link.

genre.description: The kind of work, such as 'journal-article'.

has_repository_copy.description: Whether a free copy is in a repository, such as a preprint server.

is_oa.description: Whether there is any free, legal copy.

is_paratext.description: Whether it is front matter rather than an article: a table of contents, a cover or a masthead.

journal_is_in_doaj.description: Whether the journal is listed in the Directory of Open Access Journals.

journal_is_oa.description: Whether the journal publishes only open access.

oa_location_count.description: How many free copies there are.

is_best.description: Whether Unpaywall rates this the best free copy.

landing_page_url.description: The page the copy is on.

license.description: The copy's licence, such as 'cc-by', when known.

oa_date.description: When this copy became free to read (YYYY-MM-DD).

pdf_url.description: A direct link to the PDF, when Unpaywall has one.

repository.description: The institution running the repository, if any.

url.description: The best link to the free copy: the PDF when there is one.

version.description: Which version it is: 'publishedVersion', 'acceptedVersion' (the accepted manuscript) or 'submittedVersion' (a preprint).

oa_status.description: How it is open: 'gold' (open-access journal), 'diamond' (open-access journal that charges authors nothing), 'hybrid' (open licence in a subscription journal), 'bronze' (free on the publisher's site without an open licence), 'green' (free in a repository) or 'closed'.

oa_status_meaning.description: The open-access status in plain words.

updated.description: When Unpaywall last updated this record.
